findings.published: CMA 2022-205, 'The appropriation of $2,050,00 from Free Cash to the Mitigation Revenue Stabilization Fund' (Oct 24, 2022) - page presents 'The document / 24 council orders' and reproduces their full text
findings.source_says: All 24 linked PDFs are Recycling Advisory Committee appointment orders, e.g. 'Agenda Item No. 5a / IN CITY COUNCIL / January 26, 2026 / ORDERED: That the recommendation of City Manager Yi-An Huang, on the reappointment of Dailey Brannin as a Member of the Recycling Advisory Committee for a term of three years be approved.' None mentions Free Cash, the Mitigation Revenue Stabilization Fund, or any appropriation.
findings.why_it_matters: A reader clicking 'the document' for this $2m appropriation is shown 24 unrelated 2026 committee-appointment orders as if they were the source text of the 2022 appropriation.

findings.published: Item dated Oct 24, 2022
findings.source_says: Every attached order reads 'IN CITY COUNCIL January 26, 2026'
findings.why_it_matters: The documents offered as the record of this action post-date the action by more than three years.

findings.published: 'Mar 2, 2026 - Became law as amended. Ordained unanimously, and now part of the Municipal Code.' and 'What's next / Entered the Municipal Code: these amendments became law as ordained in March 2026.'
findings.source_says: The attached document is a home rule petition to the state legislature, not a municipal ordinance: 'An Act authorizing the City of Cambridge to impose a real estate transfer fee. SECTION 1. There is hereby imposed a real estate transfer fee equal to 2 per cent of the portion of the purchase price exceeding $1,000,000...' and 'SECTION 6. Sections 1 to 5, inclusive, shall take effect upon an affirmative majority vote of the city council of the city of Cambridge. SECTION 7. Section 6 shall take effect upon its passage.'
findings.why_it_matters: A reader would conclude Cambridge has enacted a 2% real estate transfer fee into its Municipal Code. The document is a petition that must be enacted by the Massachusetts General Court before it can take effect; a council vote on a home rule petition does not put anything in the Municipal Code.

findings.published: 'Appropriations to the Combined Sewer Overflow and Stormwater Management Advisory Committee (CSO Advisory Committee) for a term of five years, effective June 8, 2026'
findings.source_says: 'ORDERED: That the recommendation of City Manager, Yi-An Huang, on the appointment of the following people as members of the Combined Sewer Overflow and Stormwater Management Advisory Committee (CSO Advisory Committee) for terms of five years effective June 8, 2026 be approved:' followed by 14 named individuals.
findings.why_it_matters: The item is a slate of 14 committee appointments, not an appropriation. The published title tells a reader the Council directed money to the committee.

findings.published: 'Jun 1, 2026 - Adopted, 8-1: the Council approved it' with 'Voted yes (8) Burhan Azeem, Tim Flaherty, Marc McGovern, Patty Nolan, E. Denise Simmons, Jivan Sobrinho-Wheeler, Cathie Zusy, Sumbul Siddiqui / Voted no (1) Ayah Al-Zubi'
findings.source_says: The adopted loan order (317537c5_ADOPTED_FY26_Loan_Order_ERP_12_000_000.pdf) carries the clerk's certification: 'In City Council June 1, 2026. Adopted by a yea and nay vote:- Yeas 9; Nays 0; Absent 0.- Attest:- Paula M. Crane, Interim City Clerk'
findings.why_it_matters: The page records Councillor Al-Zubi as voting against a $12,000,000 borrowing authorization that the City Clerk certified as adopted 9-0 with no votes in the negative.

findings.published: POR 2022-272 (Oct 24, 2022): 'Rules of the City Council be amended to add the following sentence at the beginning...' - the page reproduces 'The document / Agenda item attachment - 2 pages' inline beneath it
findings.source_says: The linked/inlined PDF is a January 22, 2026 memo: 'CAMBRIDGE CITY COUNCIL / To: Cambridge City Council / From: Councillor Patricia Nolan and Mayor Sumbul Siddiqui / Date: January 22, 2026 / Subject: Proposed Amendments to Cambridge Street Zoning Petition'. Its text (reproduced on the page) is about reducing CAM-8 heights from 8 stories to 6 and CAM-15 from 15 stories to 10 - nothing about Council Rules.
findings.why_it_matters: The page presents a 2026 zoning-amendment memo as the source document for a 2022 Council Rules order, so the reader reads text that has nothing to do with the item.

findings.published: Item dated Oct 24, 2022
findings.source_says: Attached document is dated January 22, 2026
findings.why_it_matters: The document post-dates the action by over three years.

findings.published: POR 2022-275 (Oct 24, 2022): 'Asked the City Manager to work with all relevant City departments to develop a communication on the most environmentally responsive and responsible methods of yard waste...' offered with 'The document - Agenda item attachment - 5 pages / Download original PDF'
findings.source_says: The attached PDF is committee minutes: 'HOUSING COMMITTE AND FINANCE COMMITTEE / JOINT COMMITTEE MEETING ~ MINUTES ~ Wednesday, December 3, 2025 3:00 PM Sullivan Chamber ... to discuss the feasibility and potential impacts of implementing residential development' - no mention of yard waste or leaf disposal.
findings.why_it_matters: A reader who opens the source document for this 2022 yard-waste order gets the minutes of an unrelated 2025 housing/finance hearing.

findings.published: Item dated Oct 24, 2022
findings.source_says: Attached minutes are dated December 3, 2025
findings.why_it_matters: The supporting document post-dates the action by three years.

findings.published: Jun 8, 2026 entry: 'Voted yes (8) Ayah Al-Zubi, Burhan Azeem, Tim Flaherty, Marc McGovern, E. Denise Simmons, Jivan Sobrinho-Wheeler, Cathie Zusy, Sumbul Siddiqui / Absent (1) Patty Nolan'
findings.source_says: Vote Certification in the attached PDF: 'RESULT: 8 TO 0 / YEAS: Ayah A. Al-Zubi, Burhan Azeem, Timothy R. Flaherty, Marc C. Mcgovern, Patricia M. Nolan, Jivan Sobrinho-Wheeler, Catherine Zusy, Sumbul Siddiqui / NAYS: / PRESENT: / ABSENT: E. Denise Simmons'
findings.why_it_matters: Simmons and Nolan are swapped. The page shows Simmons voting yes and Nolan absent; the certification shows the opposite. Simmons is the member who exercised the charter right on this item the week before, so her participation is exactly what a reader would look up.

findings.published: 'Jun 8, 2026 - Tabled'
findings.source_says: The June 8, 2026 Vote Certifications in the attached PDF read 'Adopted as Amended VV8: Monday, June 8, 2026' and 'CMA Placed on File: Monday, June 8, 2026 / RESULT: 8 TO 0'. No certification records a tabling on that date.
findings.why_it_matters: A reader is told the Zero Waste ordinance changes were shelved on June 8 when the certifications for that date record adoption as amended and placement on file.

findings.published: 'Jun 22, 2026 - Referred onward for further work (Referred to the economic development & university relations committee as amended, unanimous - one absent)'
findings.source_says: The attached amended order ends: 'In City Council June 22, 2026. Adopted as Amended by a yea and nay vote:- Yeas 8; Nays 0; Absent 1.- Attest:- Paula M. Crane, Interim City Clerk'
findings.why_it_matters: The order includes 'That the Cambridge City Council go on record disapproving of the License Commission's proposed working draft regulations as currently written.' The page presents the outcome as a referral to committee, so a reader would not learn the Council adopted that position.

findings.published: 'What happened: The clerk's record shows no vote or disposition against this item. Some are received and filed without one...'
findings.source_says: The attached order (908da721_AMENDED_POR_2026_25.pdf) ends: 'In City Council January 26, 2026. Adopted by a yea and nay vote:- Yeas 7; Nays 1; Present 1; Absent 0.- Attest:- Paula M. Crane, Interim City Clerk. A true copy; ATTEST:- Paula M. Crane, Interim City Clerk'
findings.why_it_matters: The page tells readers no vote was taken on the City Hall security review order; the document it links records a recorded roll call adopting it 7-1 with one present.

findings.published: 'Mar 30, 2026 - Order adopted as amended, 7-2. (Adopted as amended by substitution)' with 'Voted no (2) Tim Flaherty, E. Denise Simmons'; the copy-citation string reads 'Adopted as amended by substitution, 7-2'
findings.source_says: The attached order ends: 'In City Council March 30, 2026. Adopted by Affirmative Vote of Nine Members:- Attest:- Paula M. Crane, Interim City Clerk. A true copy;'
findings.why_it_matters: The page (and the citation it hands readers to reuse) records Flaherty and Simmons voting against the residential parking permit fee increase; the clerk's certification on the adopted order records nine affirmative votes and no negatives.

findings.published: 'Apr 13, 2026 - Order adopted as amended. (voice vote, 9 present - one absent)' with 'Voted yes (8), unanimous ... Absent (1) E. Denise Simmons'
findings.source_says: The attached amended order ends: 'In City Council April 13, 2026. Adopted as Amended by Affirmative Vote of Nine Members:- Attest:- Paula M. Crane, Interim City Clerk'
findings.why_it_matters: The page records Councillor Simmons as absent for the artificial-turf report order; the clerk certifies nine affirmative votes. The page is also internally inconsistent, saying '9 present' and 'one absent' in the same line.

findings.published: POR 2026-82 page shows 'The document / Agenda item attachment - 1 page' and reproduces its text as the item's document
findings.source_says: The displayed attachment is 'Councillor Al-Zubi Amendment to PO#5 - POR 2026-82 / Housing Needs Study / [Between first and second Ordered] That the City Manager be and hereby is requested to direct the Community Development Department (CDD) to present pros and cons of options for a housing needs study...' - the source file is named 'AAZ_Amendment_to_PO_5BROUGHT_FOR._NOT_VOTED.pdf'
findings.why_it_matters: The text shown as the item's document is a floor amendment that was brought forward and not voted, not the order the Council adopted. The adopted text is linked further down but is not what the page displays.

findings.published: 'May 4, 2026 - Order adopted as amended. (Adopted as amended, unanimous - one absent)' with 'Voted yes (8), unanimous Ayah Al-Zubi, Burhan Azeem, Tim Flaherty, Patty Nolan, E. Denise Simmons, Jivan Sobrinho-Wheeler, Cathie Zusy, Sumbul Siddiqui / Absent (1) Marc McGovern'
findings.source_says: The attached amended order ends: 'In City Council May 4, 2026. Adopted as Amended by a yea and nay vote:- Yeas 9; Nays 0; Absent 0.- Attest:- Paula M. Crane, Interim City Clerk'
findings.why_it_matters: The page records Councillor McGovern as absent from this vote; the clerk's certification records nine yeas and expressly zero absences.

findings.published: RES 2022-274 (Oct 24, 2022) 'Resolution on the death of Frank V. Gages, Jr', offered by Councillor Paul F. Toner
findings.source_says: The linked document is 'POR 2026-16 / City of Cambridge / FIRST IN COUNCIL / January 26, 2026 / COUNCILLOR NOLAN, COUNCILLOR SOBRINHO-WHEELER, COUNCILLOR MCGOVERN, MAYOR SIDDIQUI, COUNCILLOR ZUSY / WHEREAS: The global climate crisis is rapidly worsening...' - a 2026 policy order on plant-based solutions, with no mention of Frank V. Gages Jr.
findings.why_it_matters: The source document offered for a 2022 memorial resolution is an unrelated 2026 climate policy order by different sponsors.

findings.published: RES 2022-280 (Oct 24, 2022) 'Resolution on the death of John Jarcho, M.D'
findings.source_says: The linked document is 'OFFICE OF THE MAYOR / Sumbul Siddiqui / To: Cambridge City Council / From: Sumbul Siddiqui, Mayor / Date: January 22, 2026 / Subject: Announcement of Clerk search process' - no mention of John Jarcho.
findings.why_it_matters: The source document offered for a 2022 memorial resolution is a 2026 communication about the City Clerk search.

findings.published: RES 2022-281 (Oct 24, 2022) 'Congratulations to Dr. Sally Kornbluth on being elected the 18th President of Massachusetts Institute of Technology'
findings.source_says: The linked document is 'CMA 2026-13b / IN CITY COUNCIL / January 26, 2026 / ... notification of the appointment of Ellen Semonoff as a resident Member of the Cambridge Health Alliance Board of Trustees' - no mention of Sally Kornbluth or MIT.
findings.why_it_matters: The source document offered for this 2022 congratulatory resolution is a 2026 hospital-board appointment notice.

findings.published: RES 2022-282 (Oct 31, 2022) 'Resolution on the death of Andrew J. Aupperlee, Jr'
findings.source_says: The linked document is 'PENDING HOME RULE PETITIONS UPDATE - FEBRUARY 9, 2026' listing state legislative status of Cambridge home rule petitions - no mention of Andrew J. Aupperlee.
findings.why_it_matters: The source document offered for a 2022 memorial resolution is a 2026 legislative status report.

findings.published: RES 2026-89 'How it started: Jun 1, 2026 - Offered by Councillors Simmons and McGovern.'
findings.source_says: The order as filed names a single sponsor: 'RES 2026-89 / City of Cambridge / FIRST IN COUNCIL / June 1, 2026 / COUNCILLOR MCGOVERN'. Councillor Simmons does not appear anywhere in the document.
findings.why_it_matters: The page credits a councillor with co-sponsoring a memorial resolution that the filed document attributes to one member only.

findings.published: RES 2026-92 'How it started: Jun 1, 2026 - Offered by Councillors Simmons and Zusy.'
findings.source_says: The order as filed names a single sponsor: 'RES 2026-92 / City of Cambridge / FIRST IN COUNCIL / June 1, 2026 / COUNCILLOR ZUSY'. Simmons appears in the document only as a past chorus singer ('Councillor Reeves and Councillor Simmons sang with the chorus for many of those years'), not as a sponsor.
findings.why_it_matters: The page credits Councillor Simmons as a co-sponsor of the resolution; the filed document attributes it to Councillor Zusy alone.

findings.published: RES 2026-93 'How it started: Jun 1, 2026 - Offered by Councillor Simmons and Mayor Siddiqui.'
findings.source_says: The order as filed names a single sponsor: 'RES 2026-93 / City of Cambridge / FIRST IN COUNCIL / June 1, 2026 / MAYOR SIDDIQUI'. Councillor Simmons does not appear in the document.
findings.why_it_matters: The page credits Councillor Simmons as a co-sponsor of a retirement resolution the filed document attributes to the Mayor alone.
